checkpoint_training_corpus.declared_content: K562 CRISPR enhancer-gene validation labels with ABC-derived chromatin and contact features
checkpoint_training_corpus.deployment_model: full logistic regression fit on all declared training chromosomes
checkpoint_training_corpus.development_predictions: author workflow reports leave-one-chromosome-out predictions for its K562 CRISPR training data
checkpoint_training_corpus.warning: MPRA reporter labels are not enhancer-gene link labels and cannot be used to refit this classifier.

endpoint_eligibility.allelic_direction_accuracy: ineligible because rE2G does not consume REF or ALT sequence
endpoint_eligibility.eqtl_retrieval_auprc: eligible as a continuous unsigned variant-element-gene link baseline
endpoint_eligibility.mean_fisher_z_celltype_spearman: ineligible standalone; any signed effect is a separately named composite
endpoint_eligibility.typed_evidence_graph: eligible as a typed enhancer-to-gene edge source, but the current graph task has no seal and therefore no champion

gse281364.allowed_use: Development-only orthogonal activity evidence and overlap audit. Reporter output cannot validate an endogenous enhancer-gene link, and no rE2G model, threshold, or feature set may be selected using these outcomes.
gse281364.reason: The exact model Git blob was already present in the 2024 v1.0.0 release.

gse289173.allowed_use: One-time overlap of sealed variant positions with a precommitted cell-state link atlas. No QTL outcome, lineage result, threshold, or calibration enters feature construction or selection.
gse289173.reason: The exact model blob predates the GEO release and declares K562 CRISPR link training rather than MASLD QTL outcomes.

gse296875.allowed_use: Generate donor-held ATAC and ABC features for liver-domain development evaluation. The fixed K562 classifier is not refit; every upstream feature remains inside donor and genomic folds.
gse296875.reason: The exact model blob predates the GEO release by more than one year.

reference_and_topology_contract.gse281364: Same-sample different-aliquot reporter counts provide no endogenous enhancer-gene pairing.
reference_and_topology_contract.gse289173: RNA and QTL summaries are same-study unpaired; rE2G receives no sealed ATAC and produces no donor-conditioned link.
reference_and_topology_contract.gse296875: Same-nucleus provenance is retained, but the link features use donor-by-cell-state ATAC pseudobulk. Donors, not nuclei or peaks, are biological replicates.
reference_and_topology_contract.gene_authority: The upstream RefSeq-curated 2017 TSS/promoter features require an auditable crosswalk to GENCODE v49. Unmatched genes and promoter classes are explicit missing observations.
reference_and_topology_contract.missingness: Preflight must distinguish an actual numeric zero from absent assay, unresolved join, below-QC, or missing reference annotation before any transform.

split_and_leakage_rules.donors: All nuclei and wells from a GSE296875 donor stay in one outer fold. Candidate peaks, accessibility, qnorm, gene filters, and feature aggregation are fit only from outer-training donors.
split_and_leakage_rules.genomics: Cross donor folds with native-build merged LD/locus blocks. Candidate elements, contact lookups, genes, and feature neighborhoods that touch a held block cannot leak into training calibration.
split_and_leakage_rules.liver_refit: No liver classifier refit is permitted without matched liver CRISPR enhancer-gene labels. GSE281364 MPRA is the wrong modality for that fit.
split_and_leakage_rules.sealed_atlas: After selection, rebuild the named cell-state atlas from all admitted development donors, convert and freeze the classifier, hash all features and outputs, and lock before sealed variants are opened.
